_comment: Hand-transcribed metadata for distribution types the wiki doesn't publish as clean fractions (see phase1_db_and_calc_engine_spec.md §3a). Fill in from each activity's wiki page formula/pity-curve description, then re-check only when Jagex patches the underlying mechanic. This file is a starter stub, NOT complete — verify every value against the current wiki text before loading into drop_rates.metadata.

points_based_starter_example.note: Fill in avg_points_per_activity from wiki's Chambers of Xeric drop mechanics page and points_per_roll from the unique-roll-chance formula before use.

streak_adjusted_starter_example.note: pity_thresholds must be transcribed in ascending kc order from the item's wiki page. Each entry means 'from the previous threshold's kc up to this kc, the effective rate is 1/denominator'.
